rca of the issue: Hash deep-link in-session failure RCA: CharacterSheet.jsx:30-34 uses `useState(() => readHash())` lazy-initializer which executes ONLY on component mount. React Router treats hash-only URL changes (e.g., /app/characters/X#a → /app/characters/X#b) as the same route and does NOT remount, so the initializer never re-runs. There is no `useEffect` subscribing to window 'hashchange'. Mitigation: add `useEffect(() => { const onHash = () => { const h = window.location.hash.replace('#',''); if (['identity','mechanics','inventory','history'].includes(h)) setSheetTab(h); }; window.addEventListener('hashchange', onHash); return () => window.removeEventListener('hashchange', onHash); }, []);`. Fresh-load deep-linking (user arrives at URL with hash) WAS confirmed working by E1's smoke test — only in-session hash-change is broken.
